leads.summary: Darsel is an AI-powered math education chatbot that helps K12 students in developing countries learn math through simple text-based platforms like SMS and WhatsApp, reaching 400,000+ students across 3 countries.
leads.hook: You're using low-bandwidth SMS and WhatsApp to meet students where they are—processing 440+ million math questions and reaching 1 billion students who can't reliably use video-based platforms due to device and data constraints.
leads.angle_reason: Both involve LLM-powered reasoning at scale: MedVault delivers AI explanations of medical data, and Darsel delivers personalized adaptive learning through AI-powered algorithms.

leads.summary: Hub captures physical-world training data for frontier AI labs and robotics companies, collecting synchronized RGB-D video, IMU, 6-DoF pose tracking, and tactile sensor data from 150,000+ contributors across 730+ commercial sites.
leads.hook: You've built infrastructure to deliver frontier datasets in hours instead of weeks—150,000+ contributors across 730+ verified commercial sites capturing frame-level egocentric, teleoperation, hand tracking, and tactile data with QA enforcement before delivery.
leads.angle_reason: Both build scalable backend infrastructure to deterministically process and organize massive volumes of structured data: Canopy's cross-file call-graph resolution parallels your enriched data pipeline that enforces diversity caps and QA checks at scale.
